seeds.scene: A flagpole at dawn casting a long shadow westward; a watch sitting at the base reads 6:30 AM.
seeds.question: Which cardinal direction is the SUN in?
seeds.lever: Shadow points opposite the sun; westward shadow at dawn → sun is east.

seeds.scene: A customer sees three items on a counter only via a wall mirror behind the counter; mirror shows from viewer's left to right: cup, plate, spoon. The viewer is facing the counter, mirror behind it.
seeds.question: What is the actual left-to-right order of the items as the customer would see directly facing the counter?
seeds.lever: Apply mirror parity: actual order is reverse of mirror order from same viewpoint.

seeds.scene: A glass-top table viewed from above; 4 items rest at different layers — A on the table surface (top), B beneath the glass on a shelf below, C on the table surface beside A, D directly on top of A.
seeds.question: Which object is in DIRECT contact with the upper glass surface from below?
seeds.answer: B (the item resting on the lower shelf is not on glass; A and C are on top; only items resting from below would touch — none in this scene → none)
seeds.lever: Disambiguate spatial layers (above glass, glass surface, below glass).

seeds.scene: A long hallway photo with two people: A near the camera, B far down the hallway. They appear nearly equal-sized in the image.
seeds.question: Which person is taller in reality?
seeds.answer: Person B (since B is farther but appears the same size, B must be larger)
seeds.lever: Apply perspective foreshortening: equal apparent size at unequal distance → distant is larger.

seeds.scene: Two people sitting across a table from each other; an apple sits on the table to the LEFT side of person A. Person A and B face each other.
seeds.question: Is the apple on person B's left or right?
seeds.lever: Mirror perspective when facing: A's left is B's right.

seeds.scene: A stack of plates on a shelf; partial visible due to shelf overhang. Edge marks of plates visible: 8 distinct rims along the side.
seeds.question: How many plates are in the stack?
seeds.lever: Count layers via visible side edges.

seeds.scene: A photo of a box tilted at an angle; visible faces: top, front, and right side. Stickers on the box: 'TOP' on the top face, 'FRONT' on the front, 'RIGHT' on the right side.
seeds.question: If the box were placed flat with TOP face up, which sticker would face the camera (which was originally photographed)?
seeds.lever: Mentally derotate the box and identify which face the camera now sees.

seeds.scene: A queue with 5 people viewed from the side; person 1 closest to camera, person 5 farthest.
seeds.question: Who is DIRECTLY behind person 3?
seeds.lever: Resolve 'behind' relative to queue direction (away from front).

seeds.scene: A shelf with three bottles in a row: red bottle on left, blue in middle, green on right.
seeds.question: Which bottle is BETWEEN red and green?
seeds.lever: Resolve 'between' on a 1D arrangement.

seeds.scene: A sundial with shadow pointing northwest; another image of the same sundial 4 hours later shows shadow pointing northeast.
seeds.question: How did the sun's position change?
seeds.answer: moved from northeast to northwest (sun is opposite shadow)
seeds.lever: Sun moves opposite shadow; track shadow rotation to infer sun motion.

seeds.scene: A glass-floor museum walkway; visible through the floor are exhibits one level below. Someone standing on the glass appears with feet at the same image-position as an exhibit case below them.
seeds.question: Is the person ABOVE or BELOW the exhibit?
seeds.answer: above (on the glass walkway, with the case visible through it below)
seeds.lever: Disambiguate apparent overlap as vertical separation, not coplanar.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a tabletop from different angles; 5 objects visible from view 1, 6 from view 2 (one object hidden in view 1 by another).
seeds.question: How many objects are actually on the table?
seeds.lever: Combine views; count union, not single view.

seeds.scene: A warehouse aisle grid; rectangular grid with cells 2m × 3m. A forklift must travel from cell A1 to cell D4 along grid axes.
seeds.question: What is the minimum total grid-distance traveled?
seeds.lever: Compute Manhattan distance with non-unit cell sizes.

seeds.scene: Top: an object viewed from front (showing complex shape). Bottom: 4 candidate side views; only one is a 90° rotation of the front view.
seeds.question: Which side view matches the front view rotated 90°?
seeds.answer: the candidate corresponding to the rotated geometry
seeds.lever: Mentally rotate 3D shape and match to candidate.

seeds.scene: A staircase with steps photographed in oblique perspective; visible step edges: 13.
seeds.question: How many steps are in the staircase?
seeds.lever: Count step edges accurately under perspective foreshortening.

seeds.scene: A 1-liter water bottle with cylindrical body; visible water level reaches 7/10 of the way up the body. Bottle has a thinner neck above the cylinder.
seeds.question: Approximately how much water is in the bottle?
seeds.lever: Apply linear fill ratio to cylindrical body volume.

seeds.scene: An overhead floor-plan view of an office; a desk with chair pushed in, monitor on the desk facing east (window) side.
seeds.question: Which way does the seated person face?
seeds.lever: Infer person's facing from chair-monitor geometry.

seeds.scene: A clear glass jar containing several layered marbles: bottom layer 5 red, middle 4 blue, top 3 green.
seeds.question: How many marbles are at the BOTTOM of the jar?
seeds.lever: Distinguish layers vertically and count specific layer.

seeds.scene: A toy on a rotating display platform; in image 1 the toy faces camera, in image 2 (rotated 90° CCW from above) the toy's left side faces camera.
seeds.question: After another 90° CCW rotation, which side faces the camera?
seeds.lever: Sequentially apply rotation steps to track which face is forward.

seeds.scene: A room with 4 corners labeled NE, NW, SE, SW from above. A floor lamp stands in the corner where N and W walls meet.
seeds.question: Which corner is the floor lamp in?
seeds.lever: Resolve cardinal corner from intersecting wall identifiers.
